initialization: New random network and empty replay buffer; no imported weights, optimizer or trajectories.

reference.description: Random initialization created by the pipeline when the run starts.

success_criteria: Every generation completes and its duration is recorded.
At least half of the first ten attempts are promoted.
Validation policy accuracy rises and illegal policy mass falls across accepted generations.
Self-play draws stay below 20% and mean game length stays well under 256 plies.
The latest champion beats the fixed reference and an earlier champion of the same run in separate arenas.
